description: This file is part of the vtiger CRM system and handles the backend logic for updating mail scanner folder information. It initializes objects, connects to a mailbox, updates folder info, and renders a Smarty template for the Mail Scanner Folder configuration.

classes.name: Vtiger_MailScannerInfo
classes.description: Handles the mail scanner configuration and folder information for a specific scanner.

classes.name: Vtiger_MailBox
classes.description: Manages the mailbox connection and folder retrieval for the mail scanner.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the mailbox.

methods.name: getFolders
methods.description: Retrieves the list of folders from the mailbox.

methods.name: updateFolderInfo
methods.description: Updates the scanner info object with folder details.

methods.name: getAsMap
methods.description: Returns scanner info as an associative array.

methods.name: getFolderInfo
methods.description: Retrieves detailed folder information from the scanner info object.
